entries.title: Fixed Open Lid and Perforated Basket Spinner
entries.description: One newly authored whole fixed-open hand-crank salad-spinner-style exterior. A deep round thick bowl has its full blind floor and broad grounded bottom. A distinct tapered inner basket has a continuous rim, full floor and sixteen real long side windows; a low central support leaves positive side space around the basket. A complete domed lid is held in one fixed rear-open pose by a full hinge root and pin, with its underside boss and complete upper offset crank and grip still present. No chopped lid, transparent material, loose food or separate bowl variant. It differs from the rectangular laboratory centrifuge with eight blind rotor wells and from the long suspended textile basket vat: all numeric geometry is newly authored as one compact bowl/basket/manual-cover assembly. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and bounds-centred ground datum. One prop zero scenes. Fixed visual only: no spinning, drive engagement, drainage performance, food contact, washing/drying, lid closure path, hygiene, manufacture, stability or operating safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Whole Broad-Cupped-Petals Long-Column Hibiscus
entries.description: One newly authored whole static stylised hibiscus-like above-ground flowering shoot. A continuous curved stem with a finite basal cut and two broad pointed thick leaves supports a single large open cup of five genuinely thick curved broad petals. Their inner and outer faces flare from one green receptacle around a conspicuously long projecting central column, whose thicker distal end has an integral five-lobed outline. All stem, broad leaf and cupped petal stations newly drawn, not a daffodil with its corona removed or an orchid with extra side petals. The broad shared cup and long central column are the whole flower structure, not petal-count or colour variation. One plant model zero scenes. Opaque artistic exterior; no exact species, pollen/anther microanatomy, reproductive function, pollination, growth, roots, cultivation, medical or ecological performance claim.

entries.title: Fixed Split Double Hoop and Tilting Floor Stand
entries.description: One newly authored whole empty embroidery-hoop floor stand in a fixed tilted display pose. Two long feet and a braced single upright carry a transverse shaft and complete side jaw clamp. The head contains a full inner wooden hoop and a separate truly split outer band, with real radial clearance, two metal lug blocks and a complete cross bolt across the split. Both rings and local clamp share one rigid tilt about the illustrated shaft. The entire central aperture remains empty: no cloth, stitch pattern or borrowed loom mesh. Unlike the old weaving frame this is not a rectangular two-upright warp-and-cloth rig, and unlike the old windowed tambourine this is not a single pierced shell with jingles. Four opaque constant PBR materials; metres, native Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One whole prop zero scenes. Static empty craft-tool exterior only: no adjustment, clamping force, fabric tension, manufacture, ergonomic fit, bearing performance, stability or safe-use claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Cam Follower and Jointed Hammer Figure
entries.description: One newly authored complete hand-cranked cam-and-hammer wooden automaton exterior in one fixed pose. A common open four-post case carries a transverse shaft, eccentric round cam and a separate footed follower passing through a genuine deck window and bored guide. Its upper sloping link joins the elbow of a newly authored wooden figure, whose shoulder and elbow are distinct transverse pivots and whose raised hand carries one full hammer above an integrated small anvil on the same deck. This is not the old ore stamp mill resized: the follower does not itself end in a falling stamp or mortar; the whole output is an articulated side-facing figure with a shoulder-elbow chain. Unlike the old crank bird, there are no paired direct crank-to-wing links or spread wings, and unlike the lever-jaw figure there is no mouth mechanism. No old figure, anvil or machine geometry imported. Four opaque constant PBR materials; metres, native Z up and horizontal-bounds-centred ground datum. One whole toy prop zero scenes. Static mechanism-inspired art only: no motion cycle, correct kinematic timing, gravity return, actual cam contact through travel, impact, playability, child suitability, manufacturing or safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Tripod Mast and Tilted Panel Cradle
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty panel-lift-style static exterior. Three low radial outriggers end in complete caster forks, wheels and pivots around one central base. A genuinely bored tall square outer mast surrounds one separate fixed raised inner section with a transverse retaining pin. A complete side bracket carries a flanged drum, through shaft and large three-spoke handwheel with a distinct offset grip. The upper open clevis and full pivot carry one broad tilted H-shaped cradle: an entire cross spine, two whole transverse rails, four small pads and two continuous front stop hooks. No panel, load, cable routing, duplicated old hoist or engine-stand payload. All geometry newly authored; three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and whole ground-centred bounds. One prop zero scenes. Fixed visual display only: no wheel motion, telescoping travel, winch transmission, brake, board fit, lifting, load capacity, stability, construction use, installation, manufacture or safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Cutaway Drum and Opposed Shoe Display
entries.description: One complete newly authored fixed cutaway drum-and-shoe display on its own low grounded stand. A whole circular backing plate carries two complete opposed curved metal shoe webs and separate thick lining silhouettes. Half of a thick outer drum remains as a real curved wall with two finite section ends; the other half is deliberately absent to expose the assembly rather than made transparent. A lower broad anchor, upper eccentric spreader and whole short axle with rear lever relate the shoe ends. Two complete illustrative coil springs cross the front and terminate at finite shoe lugs. Unlike the old separated conical clutch, this is a radial two-shoe assembly around a common centre, not two axial cones and fork; unlike the paired rope cam cleat it encloses curved linings inside a drum perimeter rather than a rope guide. All numeric geometry newly authored, no old machine meshes imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres Z-up and horizontal complete-envelope centred ground origin. Static explanatory exterior only: no braking, friction, thermal behaviour, spring force, running fit, movement, adjustment, vehicle compatibility, installation, manufacture or engineering safety claim. No rig, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Cam and Open Pipe Coupler
entries.description: One complete newly authored static twin-cam pipe-coupler display. A thick through-bored female sleeve has two actual opposed side windows bounded by continuous front and rear annular rings. Two whole bronze eccentric-cam and long-lever bodies rotate only in their declared fixed display pose between paired exterior support ears and real vertical pins. A separate complete open male adaptor partly enters the sleeve, with a recessed circumferential exterior seat and a fully open barb-profile tail. A low base and sleeve saddle provide the display support. Unlike the old paired cam cleat or open wafer-disc valve, this complete relation surrounds a longitudinal male/female passage, uses external lateral cam levers and contains no closure disc, radial collet fingers or rope jaws. All whole geometry newly authored; no old meshes imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres Z-up and horizontal whole-envelope centred ground origin. Static exterior only: no seal, pressure rating, fit, hose compatibility, locking, rotation, pipe connection, flow, transport or safety claim; no rig or interaction.

entries.title: Static Coaxial Wheels And Standing Platform
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed two-wheel standing-transporter exterior, without branding. A broad transverse chamfered central platform carries two separate full foot pads and a central forward rising mast socket. Two large complete wheels share one transverse axle line immediately beside the platform, with integral closed stepped hub faces and separate thick curved upper wheel cowls tied into the platform sides. A continuous slightly rearward raked central mast rises from the socket into a wide T head with two full thick grips and a small opaque central control face. This is not a kick scooter with a wheel moved: there is no long fore-aft deck, separate front fork, rear brake or steering head over a front wheel. It is also not an old unicycle doubled: there is no fork above a tyre, saddle, direct pedal cranks or exposed spoked wheel. Every platform, wheel profile, cowl and mast is newly dimensioned together, without imported old vehicle meshes. One model zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred origin, both finite flat tyre tread facets on ground. Fixed illustrative upright pose only, not a physically balanced resting simulation. No rider, drive system, battery, sensors, balancing mechanism, steering linkage, animation or interaction. No self-balancing, riding, range, control, manoeuvrability, load, ergonomics, manufacture, roadworthiness or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Eccentric Slotted Rotor and Vane Display
entries.description: One newly authored complete static open-front eccentric-vane chamber display. A whole thick circular annular casing and rear plate with an actual offset shaft bore stand on two grounded roots and a common low bed. Inside is one offset circular rotor with four genuine deep open radial slots. Four independent blunt straight vane appearances occupy those slots and extend unequal distances into the circular chamber while stopping short of the wall. A full offset shaft, proud front boss, separate rear bored bearing and pedestal, rear retainer and four small rim caps belong to the same display. Not the old curved triangular rotor in a lobed cavity, nor the spiral volute with curved blades on a backing disk. All numeric geometry newly authored, three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and ground-centred bounds. One model zero scenes. Front cover is intentionally absent for a static cutaway presentation; no fluid ports, sealed compartment, working pump, sliding/rotation motion, wall contact, pressure, flow, thermodynamics, manufacturing or machinery safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Rigger and Rail Seat Single Scull
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed single-scull rowing-shell exterior. A long longitudinally sampled thick hull has a genuine bounded central well, continuous fore and aft deck and a finite narrow dry-display sole. Two whole parallel seat rails carry a fixed low backless seat, with forward inclined foot supports. Two independent complete triangular outboard riggers root at four finite hull seats and carry genuinely open U-shaped oarlocks; each holds one entire long scull shaft with inner grip and broad finite outer blade. The complete hull-to-outrigger-to-oar station and internal rail-seat arrangement distinguishes this whole craft from the old open work skiff with loose paddle and transverse benches, and the closed-deck kayak with contained backrest and no outboard bearing system. All visible numeric geometry newly authored, not an old hull with accessories extracted or appended. One whole sports prop, zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles. Metres Z up, whole horizontal envelope centred, static dry display only; no water or occupant. No rowing, sliding, oarlock motion, fit, buoyancy, hydrostatics, hydrodynamics, racing compliance, speed, loading, operation, manufacture or water-safety claim. No rigging, animation or interaction.
